argv:
Preserve explicit preparation while kernel caching is disabled

Upstream base: tile-ai/tilelang@2123e412ce2217b324c50c4ec967213906456ac5
with the unchanged ten-patch compiler prefix, head454202b2ba8d0cf10b8caf434a956755e039483f
and treebae5fe12b58cdf364efeccbabc04cd08205c43b9.

Rationale: wrapper-cache bypass for disabled caching must not discard an
explicitly prepared kernel after freeze. Default IKET mode disables caching;
its required release test exposed this retained-feature regression.

Quality: ordinary disabled-cache calls still compile afresh while thawed.
Only explicit, successful preparations may run frozen, with matching call
key, wrapper object, function/code and compile context. Missing calls and
ordinary wrapper hits remain refused. Failed fresh preparation revokes the
old permission. Repreparation clears stale call-form shortcuts. No compiler
passes, arithmetic, kernel scheduling or numerical contract change.

Tests:22 CPU controls execute real extracted JIT/prepare/freeze methods
with binding and compile-result doubles, without TileLang/TVM/Torch imports.
The positive regression fails on the original prefix while its ordinary
cache-bypass negative control passes. Native IKET, all cache-bypass tests,
full image/release/fix/functional gates and both metric boots remain required.
No GPU or serving qualification is claimed by these controls.

Upstream status: local focused integration correction; not submitted.

+"""CPU control tests of real extracted JIT/prepare methods; no compiler import.
+
+Objects returned by compilation and argument binding are doubles. The methods
+under test are parsed from source without rewriting. Native IKET, cache-bypass
+and full release tests remain mandatory; this is not GPU qualification.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import concurrent.futures
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+import inspect
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import threading
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+import unittest
+
+
+SOURCE = Path(os.environ.get("TILELANG_PREPARED_REWORK_SOURCE", Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]))
+
+
+def load_controls():
+    jit = ast.parse((SOURCE / "tilelang/jit/__init__.py").read_text())
+    cache = ast.parse((SOURCE / "tilelang/cache/kernel_cache.py").read_text())
+    wrapper = next(n for n in jit.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "JITImpl")
+    wanted = {
+        "__post_init__", "__call__", "is_lazy_mode", "_can_use_call_form_cache",
+        "_preparation_context", "_get_prepared_kernel", "_record_prepared_kernel",
+    }
+    methods = [n for n in wrapper.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in wanted]
+    standin = ast.ClassDef(name="Wrapper", bases=[], keywords=[], body=methods, decorator_list=[])
+    functions = [n for n in cache.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in {
+        "freeze", "thaw", "frozen", "_refuse_if_frozen",
+    }]
+    controls = [n for n in jit.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "_CallFormCache"]
+    controls += [n for n in jit.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "prepare"]
+    module = ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=[
+        ast.ImportFrom(module="__future__", names=[ast.alias(name="annotations")], level=0),
+        *functions, *controls, standin,
+    ], type_ignores=[]))
+    state = SimpleNamespace(cache_enabled=False, target="cuda", backend="tvm_ffi", fail=False, attempts=0, kernels=[])
+
+    class KernelNotPreparedError(RuntimeError):
+        pass
+
+    class Kernel:
+        def __call__(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            return args, kwargs
+
+    scope = {
+        "dataclass": dataclass, "field": field, "concurrent": concurrent,
+        "threading": threading, "path": os.path, "__file__": str(SOURCE / "tilelang/jit/__init__.py"),
+        "_frozen_reason": None, "_freeze_lock": threading.Lock(),
+        "KernelNotPreparedError": KernelNotPreparedError,
+        "_CALL_FORM_CACHE_MISS": object(), "_make_jit_key": lambda value: value,
+        "is_cache_enabled": lambda: state.cache_enabled,
+        "get_available_cpu_count": lambda: 2,
+        "get_prim_func_name": lambda func, default: "prepared_test",
+        "env": SimpleNamespace(
+            get_default_target=lambda: state.target,
+            get_default_execution_backend=lambda: state.backend,
+        ),
+        "logger": SimpleNamespace(warning=lambda *a: None),
+    }
+    exec(compile(module, "<actual TileLang source controls>", "exec"), scope)
+
+    def compile_kernel(*args, **kwargs):
+        state.attempts += 1
+        scope["_refuse_if_frozen"](kwargs.get("func"))
+        if state.fail:
+            raise RuntimeError("controlled preparation failure")
+        result = Kernel()
+        state.kernels.append(result)
+        return result
+
+    scope["compile"] = compile_kernel
+
+    def factory(n, threads=128):
+        return None
+
+    class Function:
+        orig_func = staticmethod(factory)
+        __name__ = "factory"
+        tensor_args = {}
+
+        def parse_args(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            bound = inspect.signature(self.orig_func).bind(*args, **kwargs)
+            bound.apply_defaults()
+            return (tuple(bound.arguments.items()), None), {}
+
+    scope["JITFunc"] = Function
+
+    def new_wrapper():
+        impl = scope["Wrapper"]()
+        impl.func = Function()
+        impl.mode = "lazy"
+        for name in ("out_idx", "target", "target_host", "execution_backend", "pass_configs", "compile_flags", "debug_root_path", "verbose"):
+            setattr(impl, name, None)
+        impl.__post_init__()
+        impl.initialize_jit_mode = lambda *a, **k: impl.mode
+        impl.get_tir = lambda *a, **k: SimpleNamespace(key=impl.func.parse_args(*a, **k)[0])
+        impl.compile = lambda *a, **k: compile_kernel(func=impl.get_tir(*a, **k))
+        return impl
+
+    return scope, state, new_wrapper
+
+
+class PreparedDisabledCacheTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.scope, self.state, self.new = load_controls()
+        self.impl = self.new()
+
+    def prepare(self, n=1024, **kwargs):
+        return self.scope["prepare"]([(self.impl, (n,), kwargs)])[0]
+
+    def freeze(self):
+        self.scope["freeze"]("test")
+
+    def assert_missing(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        with self.assertRaises(self.scope["KernelNotPreparedError"]):
+            self.impl(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    def test_disabled_ordinary_calls_bypass_both_wrapper_caches(self):
+        self.state.cache_enabled = True
+        old = self.impl(1024)
+        self.assertIs(old, self.impl(1024))
+        self.state.cache_enabled = False
+        first, second = self.impl(1024), self.impl(1024)
+        self.assertIsNot(first, old)
+        self.assertIsNot(second, first)
+        self.assertEqual(len(self.state.kernels), 3)
+
+    def test_frozen_implicit_wrapper_entry_is_not_prepared(self):
+        self.state.cache_enabled = True
+        self.impl(1024)
+        self.state.cache_enabled = False
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assert_missing(1024)
+
+    def test_explicit_disabled_preparation_runs_after_freeze(self):
+        prepared = self.prepare()
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assertIs(self.impl(1024), prepared)
+        self.assertIs(self.impl(n=1024), prepared)
+        self.assertEqual(self.state.attempts, 1)
+
+    def test_missing_or_different_specialization_still_refused(self):
+        self.prepare()
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assert_missing(2048)
+        self.assert_missing(1024, threads=64)
+
+    def test_prepare_deduplicates_normalized_call_forms(self):
+        result = self.scope["prepare"]([
+            (self.impl, (1024,), {}),
+            (self.impl, (), {"n": 1024, "threads": 128}),
+        ])
+        self.assertIs(result[0], result[1])
+        self.assertEqual(len(self.state.kernels), 1)
+
+    def test_tuning_arguments_use_the_call_key(self):
+        prepared = self.prepare(__tune_params={"threads": 64})
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assertIs(self.impl(1024, __tune_params={"threads": 64}), prepared)
+        self.assert_missing(1024)
+
+    def test_implicit_entry_does_not_replace_explicit_disabled_preparation(self):
+        self.state.cache_enabled = True
+        old = self.impl(1024)
+        self.state.cache_enabled = False
+        prepared = self.prepare()
+        self.assertIsNot(old, prepared)
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assertIs(self.impl(1024), prepared)
+
+    def test_explicit_preparation_clears_stale_call_form_objects(self):
+        self.state.cache_enabled = True
+        old = self.impl(1024)
+        self.state.cache_enabled = False
+        prepared = self.prepare()
+        self.state.cache_enabled = True
+        self.assertIsNot(prepared, old)
+        self.assertIs(self.impl(1024), prepared)
+
+    def test_thaw_keeps_ordinary_disabled_calls_fresh(self):
+        prepared = self.prepare()
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assertIs(self.impl(1024), prepared)
+        self.scope["thaw"]()
+        self.assertIsNot(self.impl(1024), prepared)
+        self.assertIsNot(self.impl(1024), self.impl(1024))
+
+    def test_explicit_disabled_reprepare_is_fresh(self):
+        old = self.prepare()
+        prepared = self.prepare()
+        self.assertIsNot(old, prepared)
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assertIs(self.impl(1024), prepared)
+
+    def test_valid_frozen_explicit_preparation_is_idempotent(self):
+        prepared = self.prepare()
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assertIs(self.prepare(), prepared)
+        self.assertEqual(self.state.attempts, 1)
+
+    def test_failed_reprepare_revokes_old_explicit_permission(self):
+        self.prepare()
+        self.state.fail = True
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, "controlled preparation failure"):
+            self.prepare()
+        self.state.fail = False
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assert_missing(1024)
+
+    def test_cleared_wrapper_entry_is_not_resurrected(self):
+        self.prepare()
+        self.impl._kernel_cache.clear()
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assert_missing(1024)
+
+    def test_replaced_wrapper_entry_is_not_prepared(self):
+        self.prepare()
+        key = self.impl.func.parse_args(1024)[0]
+        self.impl._kernel_cache[key] = object()
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assert_missing(1024)
+
+    def test_wrapper_reset_and_new_wrapper_cannot_inherit_permission(self):
+        self.prepare()
+        self.impl.__post_init__()
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assert_missing(1024)
+        with self.assertRaises(self.scope["KernelNotPreparedError"]):
+            self.new()(1024)
+
+    def test_nested_compile_option_mutation_requires_repreparation(self):
+        self.impl.pass_configs = {"test": {"value": 1}}
+        old = self.prepare()
+        self.impl.pass_configs["test"]["value"] = 2
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assert_missing(1024)
+        self.scope["thaw"]()
+        self.state.cache_enabled = True
+        prepared = self.prepare()
+        self.assertIsNot(old, prepared)
+        self.state.cache_enabled = False
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assertIs(self.impl(1024), prepared)
+
+    def test_function_and_default_target_changes_are_not_prepared(self):
+        for mutation in (lambda: setattr(self.state, "target", "llvm"),
+                         lambda: setattr(self.state, "backend", "cython"),
+                         lambda: setattr(self.impl.func, "orig_func", lambda n, threads=128: None)):
+            self.setUp()
+            self.prepare()
+            mutation()
+            self.freeze()
+            self.assert_missing(1024)
+
+    def test_replaced_python_code_is_not_prepared(self):
+        self.prepare()
+        self.impl.func.orig_func.__code__ = (lambda n, threads=128: "changed").__code__
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assert_missing(1024)
+
+    def test_compile_flags_and_output_indices_are_context_bound(self):
+        for attribute, value in (("compile_flags", ["--changed"]), ("out_idx", [-1]),
+                                 ("target", "llvm"), ("target_host", "llvm"),
+                                 ("execution_backend", "cython")):
+            self.setUp()
+            self.prepare()
+            setattr(self.impl, attribute, value)
+            self.freeze()
+            self.assert_missing(1024)
+
+    def test_enabled_repeat_preparation_keeps_valid_prepared_object(self):
+        self.state.cache_enabled = True
+        prepared = self.prepare()
+        self.assertIs(self.prepare(), prepared)
+        self.state.cache_enabled = False
+        self.freeze()
+        self.assertIs(self.impl(1024), prepared)
+        self.assertEqual(self.state.attempts, 1)
+
+    def test_launch_arguments_and_stream_are_not_rewritten(self):
+        prepared = self.prepare()
+        self.freeze()
+        kernel = self.impl(1024)
+        stream = object()
+        self.assertIs(kernel, prepared)
+        self.assertEqual(kernel("operand", stream=stream), (("operand",), {"stream": stream}))
+
+    def test_prepare_still_rejects_eager_mode(self):
+        self.impl.mode = "eager"
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "lazy-mode"):
+            self.prepare()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
